svg.title: Mica::Regex against PCRE2 with JIT
svg.desc: Geometric means over 479 cases, times as fast as PCRE2 with JIT. Run-time patterns: warm search 2.4 times as fast (29.85 µs vs 72.39 µs), compile 1.7 times (2.58 µs vs 4.38 µs), cold first search 3.0 times (27.70 µs vs 82.39 µs), process-cold 2.3 times (134.19 µs vs 305.24 µs). Static patterns over 412 cases: warm search 2.0 times (20.66 µs vs 40.64 µs), compile 24 times (159.3 ns vs 3.86 µs), cold first search 11 times (5.44 µs vs 61.31 µs), process-cold 6.2 times (43.68 µs vs 269.96 µs).
